response.text:
I can’t run in the background or proactively monitor your calendar after this response — there’s no automation or reminder tool I can use to keep checking and message you later. However I can help set up a solution so you get a daily reminder or make it easy to request checks on demand. Choose one and give the requested details, or tell me to proceed with the defaults:

Options
1) I create a recurring daily calendar event (a reminder) so you get a calendar notification each morning.
   - I need: time (e.g., 08:00), timezone (e.g., America/New_York), start date (or “today”), title (default: “Check calendar — look for moved events”), and whether it’s a one-off series or ends on a date.
2) I can check your calendar on demand whenever you message me each morning (I’ll inspect it and report changes then).
3) If you use an external automation (Zapier, IFTTT, calendar rules), I can draft instructions or the trigger/action details you can paste into that service.

Which option do you want? If option 1, confirm the time, timezone, title, and start date (I’ll ask one last confirmation before creating the event).
